<div class="about-intro">
  <p class="lead-text">
    Growing up in a <strong>hot semi-arid region (Köppen BSh)</strong> frequently affected by drought and groundwater stress, and having experienced it firsthand, I developed a deep curiosity about how aquifer systems respond to climate extremes, human use, and their broader impact on vulnerable communities.
  </p>
</div>

<div class="about-grid">

  <div class="about-card">

    <p>Virginia Tech - Specializing in <strong>Hydrogeodesy</strong>, working with Dr. Susanna Werth and Dr. Manoochehr Shirzaei.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="about-card">
    <div class="card-icon">🛰️</div>
    <h3>Research Methods</h3>
    <p>Satellite geodesy, radar remote sensing, physics-based poromechanical models, and artificial intelligence.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="about-card">
    <div class="card-icon">🌍</div>
    <h3>Background</h3>
    <p>Geo-information Science, Earth Observation, and Geography.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="about-card">
    <div class="card-icon">💧</div>
    <h3>Research Focus</h3>
    <p>Groundwater storage dynamics, geohazards, and their intersection with climate change and vulnerable communities.</p>
  </div>

</div>

<div class="about-mission">
  <blockquote>
    "My goal is to provide policymakers with critical insights for developing <strong>sustainable groundwater management policies</strong>, helping vulnerable communities tackle water scarcity and related geohazards amid changing climatic conditions."
  </blockquote>
</div>
